newsitem.title: FRANCE: Fair Cargo wins AOM, TMA gsa role at Lyon and Nant.
newsitem.headline: Fair Cargo wins AOM, TMA gsa role at Lyon and Nant.

text.p: Paris CDG-based Fair Cargo, said it had been appointed cargo sales agent for AOM French Airlines and Trans Mediterranean Airways (TMA) at two French regional airports, effective August 1.
"We have been appointed agents for AOM at Lyon and Nantes and for TMA at Nantes and both moves are new developments for the two airlines " a Fair Cargo official told Reuters.
He said Fair Cargo would be opening offices at Lyon and Nantes in the second half of August.

"These gsa agreements will entail trucking freight to AOM and TMA's hubs in Paris, but there will also be scope to generate cargo for AOM's weekly Lyon-Reunion flight and the French airline is also considering the launch of a Nantes-Reunion service."
At end-June, Fair Cargo was appointed French cargo sales agent for Hunting Cargo, a UK company which leases aircraft to DHL Worldwide Express on its intra-European line-haul services
"Our appointment followed the closure of Hunting Cargo's office at CDG and we have taken on its non-express, airport to airport product which uses DHL's French network ," the official added.
Fair Cargo is already the French cargo agent for Canadian airline, Air Transat and Hungarian carrier, Malev. - Reuters Air Cargo Service Tel+ 44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017 - www.racs.com
